_about: M1: the fight's mood and the invisible acts (docs/architecture/mood-style.md section 4; Game Design's numbers, spec-wounds.md section 9). Loaded by sim/core/mood.gd. The unit is 1/60 of a mood point, so a rate of one point per second is one unit per tick and every number is an integer. Impulses are added when their event happens; one whose actor holds AGGRESSIVE is multiplied by aggressiveMul. Casualties: perPerson x popRef / pop0 per person, at most capPerTick in one tick. Rates per tick: + bothAggressive while both fighters hold AGGRESSIVE; - decay toward the act's floor; - bothGuarded more while both hold DEFENSIVE or ESCAPE. Bands: calm below tense, tense up to frenzied, frenzied above; a band changes after the mood has stayed in the new one for dwellTicks. Aggression (permille) = base + perAct x (act - 1) + bandBonus[band], at most max: one match-wide output for the director (Encounter's Q4). crowd names the output per band.
